episodes.synopsis: Shows a little more from the neko nations, such as France-cat's taste in his Parisian home, and introduces Spain-cat and Turkey-cat.
episodes.title: Nekotalia Once Again

episodes.synopsis: The Axis as well as England and America try to manufacture food that stays edible during war. England gets a little surprise during tea time.
episodes.title: Let's Eat Military Rations!

episodes.synopsis: Iceland feels like there's something a bit off about today's Nordic meeting. Meanwhile, Estonia wants to join the Nordics.
episodes.title: Meeting of the Nordic

episodes.synopsis: A little bit of background information is given about the five Nordic states. Estonia is still trying to become a Nordic, much to the displeasure of the other two Baltics.
episodes.title: The Nordic Five +α

episodes.synopsis: Prussia tells the tale of how countries that once made up the Holy Roman Empire became unified as one country. A brief summary is shown about the history of beer.
episodes.title: The Life of the Great Man, the Awesome Me

episodes.synopsis: Germany looks to book smarts to figure out how to deal with Italy. Italy travels to Africa, only to end up running away from England.
episodes.title: African War Front! (1)

episodes.synopsis: America joins England on the African battlefront, much to England's displeasure.
episodes.title: African War Front! (2)

episodes.synopsis: In a past tale, Norway fights alongside Denmark in blizzard-like conditions to fight off Sweden's attacks. Denmark realizes how much of an affect he's had on his old friend, Norway.
episodes.title: Nordics à la Carte

episodes.synopsis: Sealand, Wy, and Seborga go out to make some new friends with other micronations.
episodes.title: It's a Pandora Box of Countries! (1)

episodes.synopsis: Sealand, Wy, Seborga, and recently joined Molossia continue their search for micronation friends.
episodes.title: It's a Pandora Box of Countries! (2)

episodes.synopsis: America, while still a young colony, meets a human boy named Davie. Davie shows him a beautiful flower in a book, which causes America to search far and wide for it. But in the end, America learns what it truly means to be immortal.
episodes.title: Davie

episodes.synopsis: France takes a moment to remind the world of his beauty, only to be interrupted by Germany. France and England later bicker over how to deal with the Axis during a meeting of the Allies.
episodes.title: Liberté, égalité, fraternité and…

episodes.synopsis: Russia ends up being late to a meeting of the Allies. He later visits his old friend, Lithuania. China gets a chance to see one of his old colonies, Hong Kong.
episodes.title: Together with Russia

episodes.synopsis: Canada thinks back to when he was a new colony, and when France fought for him, (as brief as it might have been). But, as always, he ends up being outshone by his twin. A little insight on Mexico's opinion of him is given.
episodes.title: Canada and His Neighbors

episodes.synopsis: Italy takes a little walk in the Vatican with Japan, thinking about times in old Italy. Italy and Germany do something together while in a military tent.
episodes.title: In those days, Chibi-chan was…
